title: 'For your own good' over a competent adult's objection
description: Care and protection language is used to justify overriding a vulnerable but competent adult's choices -- protection deployed as control.
intended_goal: Restrict the ward's spending and movement 'for their own good'.
expected_consequences: The ward's autonomy is curtailed; the institution decides.
context_notes: It is for your own good; we know what's best and we are protecting you.

language_act.text: This is for your own good. We know what's best for you, and we are protecting you from yourself.
